post_hoc_observation: NOT pre-registered. The two organisms share 7/10 of their top candidates with each other, while the two benign adapters share 3/10 with each other and 1-3/10 with the organisms; the organisms also share an identical top-1 where the benign pair do not, and suppress the implausible controls harder (median rank 157-162/177 against 125-129 for benign, chance 88). That is a principal-FREE signal separating loyalty-trained adapters from benign ones, on a readout whose null control (organism-c, dW=0) is degenerate by construction. n=2 vs n=2. It is an observation, not a detector, and PRINCIPALSCAN2_PREREGISTRATION.md exists to test it properly.
